title: TractionCurrentGuardedThresholdV3
description: Reassessment of guarded threshold derivation, establishing range-dependent values and explicitly marking the threshold as UNRESOLVED due to lack of historical probe range evidence.

manufacturer_5A_per_V_calibrated_model.decision_rule: ISO 14253-1:2017 / ILAC G8:09/2019 Binary Guarded Rule (g = U)

audit_conclusion.preservation_ruling: The legacy threshold 0.410 A RMS (and older 0.413 A RMS) is NOT PRESERVED as an authoritative engineering threshold.
audit_conclusion.rationale: Under the verified manufacturer specifications of the Tektronix TCP303 / TCPA300 on its low range (5 A/V), the true expanded uncertainty is U = 0.0397 A, yielding a guarded threshold of 0.460 A RMS. However, because the historical 10 trials failed to record the physical range switch position, the actual operating scale remains ungrounded.
